bio_en: Seydo (Saydo) Poghos Malkhasian was a band leader in the Mush plain whose revolutionary commitment awoke in 1894. He avenged the killing of Armenian peasants and of Father Ghazar of Aghberik monastery by killing the Kurdish brigand Yusuf with his comrade Vardan, and later escaped a police ambush after killing three attackers. He took part in the fighting of 1900 and returned afterwards to the places where 'Serobs, Hrayrs, Gurgens and Vahans' had fallen. He was killed together with the propagandist Zaven and the courier Jndo through the treachery of Ghasim bey, and the authorities buried them near the graves of Gurgen and Gevorg Chavush.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium. Death date: reported in a letter from Mush dated 10 January (Droshak Feb 1908); may be late 1907.
